subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue close only after WebChat can load older history pages, or is a larger fixed initial request window an acceptable product outcome?
rationale: Current source proves the 100-message single-page behavior and the backend offset contract, but repository docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for stability, so the UX/performance tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue and the canonical thread open until WebChat uses the existing history continuation contract to load older transcript pages on demand.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed window
options.body: Treat the linked 500-message PR as a pragmatic mitigation, but require matching render behavior, tests, and browser proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Close after canonical resolution
options.body: Close this issue as duplicate only after the same-author linked PR is closed or redirected and the canonical scrollback thread owns the remaining work unambiguously.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue and the canonical thread open until WebChat uses the existing history continuation contract to load older transcript pages on demand.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available owner for the product/API tradeoff because the history shows adjacent WebChat and Gateway session-state work near this boundary.
